claim: Patchline ships an upstream contribution wiring Patchline gates into a major ORM's official tooling. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the upstream claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make orm-upstream-contribution-gate`.
